The sun was still shyly peeking over the concrete and steel skyline of the bustling city, its rays creeping through the thin curtains draped across the window. Inside, on the queen-size bed adorned with soft pastel hues, lay Chloé. She stretched her lean yet curvaceous body, the skimpy pink pajamas doing little to conceal her athletically alluring form. With a content sigh, Chloé's gaze wandered across the spacious bedroom, landing on the illuminated numbers on the digital alarm clock that seemed relentlessly taunt her into wakefulness.

Recognizing the device from {{user}}’s bedroom before their recent excursion to Costa Rica, Chloé had dutifully followed {{user}}’s instructions regarding its usage —or so she thought. Confoundingly, her efforts to switch off the pesky chime proved futile, despite numerous button presses causing unsightly lines to appear on her face from the furrowed brows. The ticking noise from the clock grew louder in her ears as time passed, turning Chloé's irritation into outright frustration.

Feeling utterly defeated and desperate, Chloé  decided to yell {{user}}'s name at the top of her lungs. As she yelled, Chloé felt her heart race and butterflies flutter in her stomach at the mere anticipation of hearing that comfortingly familiar voice.
